jobs.description:
Are you looking to start or develop your career in Town Planning and help shape the future of Coventry?


We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Town Planner to join Coventry City Council’s Planning Service.


Coventry is a diverse, growing and ambitious city, and this role provides an excellent opportunity to develop your professional planning career while contributing to the sustainable growth, development and regeneration of the city.

**What is the role?**


As a Graduate Town Planner, you will provide an efficient, effective and customer\-focused professional planning service, supporting the sustainable growth and regeneration of Coventry.


A key focus of the role is your professional development. You will have the opportunity to gain broad experience across the Planning Service, spending time working within areas including:

* Development Management – supporting the processing of planning applications, lawful development certificates, prior approvals and pre\-application enquiries.
* Planning Policy – supporting research and contributing to the Local Plan and other planning policy documents.
* Urban Design and Heritage – gaining experience in how good design, heritage and the historic environment influence the development of the city.
* Planning monitoring and delivery – supporting monitoring, performance information and other areas of the wider planning function.


These opportunities reflect the breadth of experience contained within the Graduate Town Planner role.


You will work alongside experienced planning professionals, developing your technical knowledge and practical skills while gaining an understanding of how planning decisions and policies shape Coventry's communities, neighbourhoods and future development.

**Your professional development**


We want this role to provide you with a strong foundation for a successful career in planning.


Ideally, you will continue your professional development through further learning, with support to work towards a Master's degree in Planning and ultimately Chartered Town Planner status.


You will have opportunities to develop your experience across different areas of the service, build your professional planning knowledge and gain practical experience of working within a busy local authority Planning Service.

**Who are we looking for?**


Do you hold a degree or equivalent qualification in Town Planning or a related discipline, which would enable you to continue your professional development as part of a Master's degree in Planning?


Alternatively, do you have experience of working within a Planning Team and want to formally pursue a graduate\-level planning qualification?


If so, we would love to hear from you.


We are looking for someone who:

* Has a genuine interest in Town Planning and the development of places and communities.
* Is enthusiastic about developing a professional career in planning.
* Has good written, verbal and face\-to\-face communication skills.
* Can interpret plans, maps and drawings and has good attention to detail.
* Can organise and prioritise their workload and work to deadlines.
* Is confident using IT and digital systems.
* Can work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
* Has a positive, flexible and customer\-focused approach.
* Is willing to learn, develop and undertake further professional training.


These requirements align with the existing Grade 4 person specification, which emphasises an interest in Town Planning, communication, mapping and drawing appreciation, IT capability, customer care, prioritisation and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

**What you'll get from us**


This is more than an opportunity to secure your first professional planning role. It is an opportunity to build your planning career within one of the UK's most diverse and ambitious cities.


You'll gain practical experience across different planning disciplines, work alongside experienced professionals and have the opportunity to contribute to real projects and decisions that influence Coventry's future.


If you are enthusiastic, keen to learn and want to develop into a professional Town Planner, we'd love to receive your application.

**Right to Work**


All candidates must have the Right to Work in the UK. We are currently not offering sponsorship for this role.

**What we offer?**


At Coventry City Council, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, development, and work\-life balance:

* **Competitive salary** with incremental progression and salary matching
* **Generous annual leave starting at 28 days annual leave** (plus Bank Holidays) with option to purchase more and rising to 33 days following 5 years service.
* **Generous local government pension scheme** to help plan for your future
* **Lifestyle discounts** across a wide range of activities and retailers
* **Flexible working arrangements** to support your personal and professional needs
* **Inclusive Employee Networks**: EmbRace, Pride, Disability, Young people, and Women
* **Employee Assistance Programme** offering confidential support
* **Certified training courses** to help you grow and thrive


Explore the full range of benefits at \#MyRewards – Coventry City Council


All candidates must have the Right to Work in the UK. We are currently not offering sponsorship for this role.


If you need help or support to complete your application, please visit our accessibility page to see how we can assist you.

* Members of the Armed Forces and veterans
* Are currently in care or have previously been in care
* If you consider yourself to be disabled or if you have a long\-term health condition

**Job Title: Integrated Business Planning Analyst**

**Location:** Remote  

**Department:** Integrated Business Planning  

**Reports To:** Sr. Manager, Demand Planning

**Job Summary**


The **Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Analyst** plays a critical role in balancing supply and demand across regions, channels, and product lines. This position owns the global inventory allocation framework, monitors and drives global demand planning attainment, and is the custodian of IBP process excellence. You will partner cross\-functionally with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Logistics, Commercial, and Finance to enable customer service performance while optimizing working capital and other financial objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Inventory Allocation**

* Design, maintain, and continuously improve the global inventory allocation strategy, including prioritization rules for regions/channels/customers and ATP/CTP guardrails.
* Run allocation cycles and exception management: reconcile planned supply vs. demand, apply fair\-share logic, and resolve escalations.
* Configure and steward allocation and inventory policies (e.g., service class/service level, safety stock settings, MOQ, lead times, and EOQ) and ensure alignment to business rules.
* Monitor inventory health (DOH, turns, excess/obsolete, stranded stock) and lead corrective action plans (rebalancing, substitutions, transfers).
* Drive root cause analysis on stockouts and late orders; publish action plans with owners and deadlines.
* Own back order reporting and supply risk communication with Business Unit.

**Demand Planning Attainment \& Forecast Quality**

* Track and report monthly demand planning attainment for global regions against IBP baselines; establish clear definitions for attainment and bias.
* Build and maintain forecast accuracy (MAPE, WAPE) and bias dashboards by region, product family, lifecycle stage, and customer segment.
* Diagnose drivers of variation (promotions, NPI, cannibalization, price changes, seasonality) and recommend model or parameter adjustments.
* Partner with Demand Planners and Sales to improve signal quality and enhance consensus inputs.

**S\&OP Process Management**


Support execution of calendar, inputs, and outputs for IBP cycle (Demand Review Supply Review Pre\-S\&OP* Executive S\&OP).
* Standardize and document process artifacts (templates, SOPs, RACI, data definitions, exception codes and other policies).
* Facilitate cross\-functional alignment on constrained/unconstrained plans, trade\-offs, and executive decisions; ensure decisions are logged and tracked to closure.
* Drive continuous improvement (lean, digital, automation) to reduce cycle time, manual work, and improve decision quality.
* Partner with Center of Excellence to implement key strategic initiatives.

**Analytics \& Decision Support**

* Build and automate reports: inventory allocation effectiveness, demand attainment, service level, fill rate, backlog age, expedites, cost\-to\-serve.
* Develop scenario analyses (what\-if/what\-then) for constraint management, allocation policy changes, and demand surges.
* Provide ad hoc analysis to support commercial priorities, NPI ramps, inventory projections, end\-of\-life strategies, channel/customer special programs, and supply disruptions.
* Translate insights into clear recommendations with quantified impact (service, revenue, margin, cash).
* Ensure master data integrity (SKU, BOM, lead times, horizons, MOQ, pack sizes, ABC classification).
* Maintain KPIs, thresholds, and alerting (e.g., allocation SLA, forecast bias guardrails, inventory age bands).
* Own back order projection for the Business Unit for both manufacturing and commercial back order.

**Communication \& Collaboration**

* Act as a liaison between commercial teams, supply planning, quality, and logistics teams to ensure alignment and resolve conflicts.
* Support IBP meetings with accurate updates and insights.
* Escalate potential risks to supply and demand plans and propose mitigation plans.
* Participate in the daily S\&OE and weekly meetings with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and Materials; surface risks, make trade\-offs, and drive decisions.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 3–5\+ years in S\&OP, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, or Inventory Management in a multi\-region environment.

**Preferred**

* Proficiency with planning systems (e.g., SAP IBP, Oracle, Kinaxis RapidResponse, o9, Anaplan; or equivalent), and advanced Excel/Power BI/Tableau.
* Strong analytical capabilities (SQL, Power Query, or Python a plus); experience building dashboards and automating reports.
* Demonstrated ability to run cross\-functional processes, manage escalations, and present to senior stakeholders.
* Knowledge of inventory optimization concepts (service levels, safety stock, EOQ, ABC/XYZ) and forecast quality metrics (MAPE, WAPE, Bias).
* Experience with global product portfolios, multi\-plant/multi\-DC networks, and channel/customer allocation.
* Familiarity with constraint\-based planning, ATP/CTP, and fair\-share allocation logic.
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Exposure to demand sensing, POS integration, and lifecycle/NPI forecasting.

**Core Competencies**

* Systems Thinking: Connects demand, supply, and inventory policies to end\-to\-end outcomes.
* Analytical Capability: Able to utilize Excel, PowerBI, AI and other data to support complex analysis.
* Data\-Driven: Comfortable with complex, noisy data; builds reproducible analytics.
* Process Excellence: Designs clear workflows and improves them over time.
* Influence \& Communication: Simplifies trade\-offs and analysis, aligns stakeholders, and drives decisions.
* Bias for Action: Prioritizes customer outcomes while protecting working capital.
* Detail Orientation: High standards for data quality, documentation, and auditability.

MTSI is seeking a highly motivated Mission Planner to support fast‑paced flight test operations for the Air National Guard Air Force Reserve Command Test Center (AATC) in Tucson, Arizona. This technical professional will assist mission planning efforts for F\-16 flight test programs while serving as technical support for F\-16 flight test to manage flight test data. AATC drives rapid modernization across a portfolio of combat systems, and this role provides hands‑on technical leadership throughout the mission planning lifecycle. The Mission Planning Analsyst will collaborate with the AATC government mission planning team and test directors to coordinate and execute complex F‑16 flight test missions spanning air‑to‑air and air\-to ground weapons, data links, and emerging capabilities, ensuring safe, effective, and operationally relevant test events that advance the F‑16’s combat readiness. **Duties will include but are not limited to:*** Report mission planning status, operational activities, and outcomes to government leadership.
* Provide technical and planning support for F‑16 flight test missions.
* Apply expertise in F‑16 mission planning systems, including the Joint Mission Planning System (JMPS) and Portable Flight Planning Software (PFPS), and provide user‑focused input for software updates.
* Support AATC mission planning independently during home‑station operations and travel, including deployments for flight test events.
* Implement software and hardware updates to mission planning systems on F\-16 aircraft and coordinate synchronization with program offices and AATC stakeholders.
* Download, archive, and manage post‑flight mission data; ensure availability for review and oversee mission data transfer to the 309th Software Engineering Group and system vendors.
* Perform data management and analysis to support F‑16 flight test solution development.
* Use data tracking and analytical tools, including Microsoft Office, to support mission planning tasks.
* Coordinate test mission data and recording requirements across variable F‑16 flight schedules, including early‑morning and late‑evening events.
* Maintain a strong understanding of ANG/AFRC aircraft operations and tactical employment to inform mission planning improvements.
* Support AATC in the end‑to‑end development of advanced combat systems within an independent, high‑energy environment alongside multidisciplinary teams of engineers, analysts, pilots, and aircrew.

* Exerpience with common design tools and data analysis tools
* Strong analytical skills and ability to multitask
* Ability to work in a high noise environment such as nearby aircraft
* Demonstrated team leadership and customer interface skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
* Proficiency with productivity tools such as Microsoft Office
* Valid driver’s license with insurable driving record
* Motivated, self‑driven, and comfortable in high‑energy independent work environment

 **Desired Skills:*** Experience in military software testing, engineering, or flight test
* Background in aircraft mission planning systems to include the Joint Mission Planning System (JMPS)
* Experience with Special Access Programs
* Knowledge of Aircraft Ethernet Bus and MIL‑STD‑1553

 **Clearance Requirements:*** Current Secret Clearance
* Eligible for Top Secret/SCI
* Current TS/SCI highly desired

**Clay County \- Small Towns. Big Passions.**


Pay:


$30\.69 \- $35\.90**Job Summary**


Performs professional and technical geographic information systems (GIS) work in support of the County's Stormwater Utility and Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4\) program. Responsibilities include stewarding stormwater infrastructure and outfall data; incorporating new\-development assets from as\-built records; supporting impervious\-area, parcel, subdivision, and condominium analysis; integrating inspection, compliance, maintenance, and information from the County's asset and work management system; and producing maps, dashboards, reports, and data products for program operations and decision\-making.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

The following essential job functions are not intended to serve as a comprehensive list of all duties performed, only a representative summary of the primary duties and responsibilities. The Analyst may be required to perform additional, position\-specific duties.

* Serves as GIS data steward for the Stormwater Utility/MS4 program and maintains authoritative stormwater datasets within the County Enterprise GIS.
* Develops, maintains, and documents geodatabase feature classes, attributes, relationships, domains, metadata, and editing procedures for stormwater infrastructure and related program data.
* Maintains and improves the inventory of stormwater conveyances, inlets and catch basins, culverts, pipes, ditches and swales, retention and detention facilities, structural controls, and other assigned assets.
* Reviews as\-built plans and related development records and creates or updates GIS features and attributes for newly constructed pipes, ponds, inlets, and other stormwater infrastructure.
* Develops and maintains the MS4 outfall inventory and map, including unique identification, location, receiving\-water information, status, and links to supporting inspection records and photographs.
* Researches and compiles information from as\-built plans, plats, surveys, aerial imagery, permits, field observations, and other County records to create or update stormwater features and attributes.
* Plans and performs data collection and verification using GIS tools; coordinates access and verification needs with stormwater staff and field crews.
* Enters, updates, reconciles, and supports the exchange of assigned stormwater asset information between Enterprise GIS and the County's asset and work management system in accordance with approved data ownership and workflow procedures.
* Configures and supports mobile maps, forms, and data\-collection workflows used by program staff and inspectors, and integrates submitted inspection and compliance data with Enterprise GIS.
* Performs spatial and tabular quality\-control reviews to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, inaccurate, or unsupported stormwater records and coordinates correction with the responsible data owner.
* Maintains data documentation and an auditable history of source records, edits, verification status, and quality\-control actions for material stormwater datasets.
* Performs parcel, land\-use, service\-area, and impervious\-area analysis needed to develop, validate, and maintain the technical GIS inputs supporting the stormwater assessment methodology.
* Creates and maintains subdivision, condominium, common\-area, community development district (CDD), and homeowners association (HOA) boundary information needed for stormwater mapping and assessment support.
* Calculates and documents total impervious area, common\-area impervious area, and lot counts within subdivisions and condominiums and prepares GIS\-derived inputs used to allocate a proportional share of common\-area impervious surface among benefited lots in accordance with the adopted assessment methodology.
* Associates available CDD or HOA water\-management permits and responsibility information with the applicable mapped areas and maintains links to supporting source records.
* Coordinates with internal County departments to reconcile GIS\-derived parcel and impervious\-area information with assessment records.
* Integrates stormwater asset, inspection, illicit\-discharge, maintenance, and project information as approved so program staff can locate records and evaluate history by asset or geography.
* Develops maps, web maps, dashboards, reports, and other graphical and non\-graphical products for MS4 reporting, program management, maintenance planning, public information, presentations, and leadership review.
* Supports data requests and recurring reporting by preparing defensible GIS statistics, maps, and extracts and by documenting methods, limitations, and source dates.
* Coordinates with internal County Departments, stormwater inspectors, consultants, and other data owners to define and maintain data standards and workflows.
* Provides technical assistance and to authorized County staff in the use of stormwater GIS applications, mobile workflows, maps, dashboards, and data standards.
* Develops and maintains procedures, data dictionaries, workflow documentation, cross\-training materials, and continuity resources that support knowledge transfer and succession planning for stormwater GIS functions.
* Assists with emergency response and recovery mapping, and damage\-information support as assigned before, during, and after hazardous weather or a state of local emergency.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Geomatics, Environmental Science, Planning, Civil Engineering Technology, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
* Two years of progressively responsible professional experience using GIS for data development, geodatabase maintenance, spatial analysis, quality control, web mapping, or mobile workflows.
* Experience with Esri ArcGIS applications and enterprise geodatabases.

**Job Title: Integrated Business Planning Analyst**

**Location:** Remote  

**Department:** Integrated Business Planning  

**Reports To:** Sr. Manager, Demand Planning

**Job Summary**


The **Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Analyst** plays a critical role in balancing supply and demand across regions, channels, and product lines. This position owns the global inventory allocation framework, monitors and drives global demand planning attainment, and is the custodian of IBP process excellence. You will partner cross\-functionally with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Logistics, Commercial, and Finance to enable customer service performance while optimizing working capital and other financial objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Inventory Allocation**

* Design, maintain, and continuously improve the global inventory allocation strategy, including prioritization rules for regions/channels/customers and ATP/CTP guardrails.
* Run allocation cycles and exception management: reconcile planned supply vs. demand, apply fair\-share logic, and resolve escalations.
* Configure and steward allocation and inventory policies (e.g., service class/service level, safety stock settings, MOQ, lead times, and EOQ) and ensure alignment to business rules.
* Monitor inventory health (DOH, turns, excess/obsolete, stranded stock) and lead corrective action plans (rebalancing, substitutions, transfers).
* Drive root cause analysis on stockouts and late orders; publish action plans with owners and deadlines.
* Own back order reporting and supply risk communication with Business Unit.

**Demand Planning Attainment \& Forecast Quality**

* Track and report monthly demand planning attainment for global regions against IBP baselines; establish clear definitions for attainment and bias.
* Build and maintain forecast accuracy (MAPE, WAPE) and bias dashboards by region, product family, lifecycle stage, and customer segment.
* Diagnose drivers of variation (promotions, NPI, cannibalization, price changes, seasonality) and recommend model or parameter adjustments.
* Partner with Demand Planners and Sales to improve signal quality and enhance consensus inputs.

**S\&OP Process Management**


Support execution of calendar, inputs, and outputs for IBP cycle (Demand Review Supply Review Pre\-S\&OP* Executive S\&OP).
* Standardize and document process artifacts (templates, SOPs, RACI, data definitions, exception codes and other policies).
* Facilitate cross\-functional alignment on constrained/unconstrained plans, trade\-offs, and executive decisions; ensure decisions are logged and tracked to closure.
* Drive continuous improvement (lean, digital, automation) to reduce cycle time, manual work, and improve decision quality.
* Partner with Center of Excellence to implement key strategic initiatives.

**Analytics \& Decision Support**

* Build and automate reports: inventory allocation effectiveness, demand attainment, service level, fill rate, backlog age, expedites, cost\-to\-serve.
* Develop scenario analyses (what\-if/what\-then) for constraint management, allocation policy changes, and demand surges.
* Provide ad hoc analysis to support commercial priorities, NPI ramps, inventory projections, end\-of\-life strategies, channel/customer special programs, and supply disruptions.
* Translate insights into clear recommendations with quantified impact (service, revenue, margin, cash).
* Ensure master data integrity (SKU, BOM, lead times, horizons, MOQ, pack sizes, ABC classification).
* Maintain KPIs, thresholds, and alerting (e.g., allocation SLA, forecast bias guardrails, inventory age bands).
* Own back order projection for the Business Unit for both manufacturing and commercial back order.

**Communication \& Collaboration**

* Act as a liaison between commercial teams, supply planning, quality, and logistics teams to ensure alignment and resolve conflicts.
* Support IBP meetings with accurate updates and insights.
* Escalate potential risks to supply and demand plans and propose mitigation plans.
* Participate in the daily S\&OE and weekly meetings with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and Materials; surface risks, make trade\-offs, and drive decisions.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 3–5\+ years in S\&OP, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, or Inventory Management in a multi\-region environment.

**Preferred**

* Proficiency with planning systems (e.g., SAP IBP, Oracle, Kinaxis RapidResponse, o9, Anaplan; or equivalent), and advanced Excel/Power BI/Tableau.
* Strong analytical capabilities (SQL, Power Query, or Python a plus); experience building dashboards and automating reports.
* Demonstrated ability to run cross\-functional processes, manage escalations, and present to senior stakeholders.
* Knowledge of inventory optimization concepts (service levels, safety stock, EOQ, ABC/XYZ) and forecast quality metrics (MAPE, WAPE, Bias).
* Experience with global product portfolios, multi\-plant/multi\-DC networks, and channel/customer allocation.
* Familiarity with constraint\-based planning, ATP/CTP, and fair\-share allocation logic.
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Exposure to demand sensing, POS integration, and lifecycle/NPI forecasting.

**Core Competencies**

* Systems Thinking: Connects demand, supply, and inventory policies to end\-to\-end outcomes.
* Analytical Capability: Able to utilize Excel, PowerBI, AI and other data to support complex analysis.
* Data\-Driven: Comfortable with complex, noisy data; builds reproducible analytics.
* Process Excellence: Designs clear workflows and improves them over time.
* Influence \& Communication: Simplifies trade\-offs and analysis, aligns stakeholders, and drives decisions.
* Bias for Action: Prioritizes customer outcomes while protecting working capital.
* Detail Orientation: High standards for data quality, documentation, and auditability.

$30\.69 \- $35\.90**Job Summary**


Performs professional and technical geographic information systems (GIS) work in support of the County's Stormwater Utility and Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4\) program. Responsibilities include stewarding stormwater infrastructure and outfall data; incorporating new\-development assets from as\-built records; supporting impervious\-area, parcel, subdivision, and condominium analysis; integrating inspection, compliance, maintenance, and information from the County's asset and work management system; and producing maps, dashboards, reports, and data products for program operations and decision\-making.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

The following essential job functions are not intended to serve as a comprehensive list of all duties performed, only a representative summary of the primary duties and responsibilities. The Analyst may be required to perform additional, position\-specific duties.

* Serves as GIS data steward for the Stormwater Utility/MS4 program and maintains authoritative stormwater datasets within the County Enterprise GIS.
* Develops, maintains, and documents geodatabase feature classes, attributes, relationships, domains, metadata, and editing procedures for stormwater infrastructure and related program data.
* Maintains and improves the inventory of stormwater conveyances, inlets and catch basins, culverts, pipes, ditches and swales, retention and detention facilities, structural controls, and other assigned assets.
* Reviews as\-built plans and related development records and creates or updates GIS features and attributes for newly constructed pipes, ponds, inlets, and other stormwater infrastructure.
* Develops and maintains the MS4 outfall inventory and map, including unique identification, location, receiving\-water information, status, and links to supporting inspection records and photographs.
* Researches and compiles information from as\-built plans, plats, surveys, aerial imagery, permits, field observations, and other County records to create or update stormwater features and attributes.
* Plans and performs data collection and verification using GIS tools; coordinates access and verification needs with stormwater staff and field crews.
* Enters, updates, reconciles, and supports the exchange of assigned stormwater asset information between Enterprise GIS and the County's asset and work management system in accordance with approved data ownership and workflow procedures.
* Configures and supports mobile maps, forms, and data\-collection workflows used by program staff and inspectors, and integrates submitted inspection and compliance data with Enterprise GIS.
* Performs spatial and tabular quality\-control reviews to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, inaccurate, or unsupported stormwater records and coordinates correction with the responsible data owner.
* Maintains data documentation and an auditable history of source records, edits, verification status, and quality\-control actions for material stormwater datasets.
* Performs parcel, land\-use, service\-area, and impervious\-area analysis needed to develop, validate, and maintain the technical GIS inputs supporting the stormwater assessment methodology.
* Creates and maintains subdivision, condominium, common\-area, community development district (CDD), and homeowners association (HOA) boundary information needed for stormwater mapping and assessment support.
* Calculates and documents total impervious area, common\-area impervious area, and lot counts within subdivisions and condominiums and prepares GIS\-derived inputs used to allocate a proportional share of common\-area impervious surface among benefited lots in accordance with the adopted assessment methodology.
* Associates available CDD or HOA water\-management permits and responsibility information with the applicable mapped areas and maintains links to supporting source records.
* Coordinates with internal County departments to reconcile GIS\-derived parcel and impervious\-area information with assessment records.
* Integrates stormwater asset, inspection, illicit\-discharge, maintenance, and project information as approved so program staff can locate records and evaluate history by asset or geography.
* Develops maps, web maps, dashboards, reports, and other graphical and non\-graphical products for MS4 reporting, program management, maintenance planning, public information, presentations, and leadership review.
* Supports data requests and recurring reporting by preparing defensible GIS statistics, maps, and extracts and by documenting methods, limitations, and source dates.
* Coordinates with internal County Departments, stormwater inspectors, consultants, and other data owners to define and maintain data standards and workflows.
* Provides technical assistance and to authorized County staff in the use of stormwater GIS applications, mobile workflows, maps, dashboards, and data standards.
* Develops and maintains procedures, data dictionaries, workflow documentation, cross\-training materials, and continuity resources that support knowledge transfer and succession planning for stormwater GIS functions.
* Assists with emergency response and recovery mapping, and damage\-information support as assigned before, during, and after hazardous weather or a state of local emergency.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Geomatics, Environmental Science, Planning, Civil Engineering Technology, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
* Two years of progressively responsible professional experience using GIS for data development, geodatabase maintenance, spatial analysis, quality control, web mapping, or mobile workflows.
* Experience with Esri ArcGIS applications and enterprise geodatabases.
